nodes.label: The Fourteenth Axis and the Tower's Last Stage
nodes.rationale: The successor reading of MC33: the limit's existence is the law's and its value the world's, and the world — asked the one question answerable without a further ruling, is the ladder finite — has answered yes. L = fill(D_last) > 0, so L = 0, admissible from inside, is excluded from outside.

nodes.label: Relabel versus Measurement, Barred at the Door
nodes.rationale: A relabel closes and lowers fill exactly as a measurement does, and closure sees nothing but fill and order, so closure cannot tell them apart — which is why every route to L = 0 is a disguised repetition. What bars the relabel is the door's independence requirement, not closure; every genuine axis of the tower is therefore a measurement.

nodes.label: L = fill(D_last) > 0 — bracket [0.047 %, 0.333 %]
nodes.rationale: Over the joint (k, 2J_c, 2J) census of Λ₁₃, 91 classes, every combination of the nuclear-spin cap and the open rulings lands L in [0.047 %, 0.333 %]; the record-consistent reading (I = 7, core J read as source J, field-free) gives L = 0.283507 % at a last stage of fifteen, 0.302400 % if the primordial isomer's I = 9 is admitted.
